behaviors.description: Install A and its runtime, query and run A, update to B, query and run B, uninstall and query absence.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation; prepared A/B repositories; session bus and sandbox support.
behaviors.expected: Both installed refs match the fixture; app reports A then B; app is absent after uninstall.

behaviors.description: Update installed A to advertised B while a required repository object download fails.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation of A; repository advertises B; fixture server denies payload downloads.
behaviors.expected: A payload download is attempted and denied, update fails, installed commit remains A and app still reports A.

behaviors.description: Update an installed app while its remote still advertises the installed commit.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation of A and its runtime; healthy repository still at A.
behaviors.expected: Update succeeds; app and runtime commits are unchanged and the app still reports A.

behaviors.description: Repeat a plain install of A after its remote advertises B.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation of A and its runtime; healthy repository advanced to B.
behaviors.expected: CLI succeeds with an already-installed warning; libflatpak returns ALREADY_INSTALLED. Both preserve the app/runtime commits and runnable A, without upgrading to B.

behaviors.description: Attempt to install a well-formed app ref absent from a healthy configured remote.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh empty user installation; fixture remote configured; requested ref is absent from the repository.
behaviors.expected: CLI fails and identifies the missing ref; libflatpak returns REF_NOT_FOUND. Successful public enumeration shows no installed apps or runtimes afterward.

behaviors.description: Query and attempt to uninstall a well-formed ref that is not installed, alongside an existing app.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation of A and its runtime; requested app ref has never been installed.
behaviors.expected: Both operations fail: CLI diagnostics identify the absent ref and libflatpak returns NOT_INSTALLED. After each operation, installed app/runtime commits remain unchanged and A is runnable.

behaviors.description: Retry an update after restoring downloads previously denied by the fixture server.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation of A and its runtime; repository advertises B; initial payload downloads fail.
behaviors.expected: Initial update fails after an injected download error and leaves app/runtime commits and runnable A intact. After downloads are restored, a new update succeeds, downloads B, preserves the runtime, and makes B queryable and runnable.

behaviors.description: Persist remote names, URLs, titles and priorities; modify them and remove one while preserving another.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh empty user installation and a healthy local fixture repository.
behaviors.expected: Separate queries return exact added and modified properties, remotes follow distinct-priority order, and deletion leaves only the untouched remote. Library checks also cover unsetting a title.

behaviors.description: Check the public library's documented descending priority order and earlier-added-first tie order.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation with three newly added remotes; two share priority and have reverse-alphabetical names.
behaviors.expected: Higher priority remotes precede the lower priority remote, and the earlier added equal-priority remote precedes the later one. The contract remains strict even when reference Flatpak disagrees.

behaviors.description: Reject a resolved transaction in the public ready signal, then accept a fresh transaction.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh user installation and healthy local fixture repository.
behaviors.expected: Returning FALSE from ready fails the transaction before new-operation signals and leaves installed-ref enumeration empty. A subsequent transaction accepting ready installs the app and runtime at the fixture commits.
